import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/chazu/dev/zig/birnam')
work=Path('/tmp/birnam-74t-application-profile');work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
prefix=Path('/tmp/birnam-74t-aggregate-prefix').resolve()
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
proof_path=root/'docs/measurements/74x-literal-control-production-correctness.json'
proof=json.loads(proof_path.read_text())
assert proof['status']==proof['production_verification']=='passed'
assert all(sha(root/k)==v for k,v in proof['sources'].items())
base_path=root/'bench/native-tier-focus.birnam';base=base_path.read_text()
paths=[prefix/'bin/birnam',prefix/'share/birnam/rust-install.json',*sorted((prefix/'lib').glob('*.dylib'))]
receipt={'status':'running','scope':'Diagnostic native sampling of existing application workloads with default production optimization settings. No host qualification, timing comparison or speed claim. Collection repetitions increase from 5 to 25 only to allow sampling; cold materialization retains the original 5 batches. Sampling starts after reported warmup. RSS readings are point samples, not process peaks.','correctness_sha256':sha(proof_path),'source_sha256':proof['sources'],'original_fixture_sha256':sha(base_path),'installed_sha256':{str(p):sha(p) for p in paths},'driver_sha256':sha(__file__),'rows':[]}
out=work/'receipt.json'
def save():out.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
save()
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('BIRNAM_','DYLD_','BENCH_'))}
try:
 for scenario,batches in [('portable-collections',25),('materialize-cold',5)]:
  fixture=work/(scenario+'.birnam');code=base.replace('[5 timesRepeat: [|',f'[{batches} timesRepeat: [|');fixture.write_text(code)
  assert code.count(f'[{batches} timesRepeat: [|')==1
  log=work/(scenario+'.log');sample=work/(scenario+'.sample');sample_log=work/(scenario+'-sample.log')
  row={'scenario':scenario,'batches':batches,'fixture':str(fixture),'fixture_sha256':sha(fixture),'rss_samples_kib':[]}
  receipt['rows'].append(row);save()
  print('Starting',scenario,flush=True)
  with log.open('w') as output, sample_log.open('w') as diagnostics:
   child=subprocess.Popen([str(prefix/'bin/birnam'),str(fixture)],cwd=root,env=dict(env,NATIVE_TIER_FOCUS=scenario),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=output,text=True,bufsize=1)
   row['pid']=child.pid
   profiler=None
   lines=[]
   try:
    for line in child.stdout:
     output.write(line);output.flush();lines.append(line)
     if line.startswith('warmup-us ') and profiler is None:
      assert child.poll() is None
      identity=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-ww','-p',str(child.pid),'-o','command='],text=True).strip()
      row['sampled_process_start']=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-p',str(child.pid),'-o','lstart='],text=True).strip()
      assert str(prefix/'bin/birnam') in identity,identity
      row['sampled_process']=identity
      profiler=subprocess.Popen(['sample',str(child.pid),'3','1','-file',str(sample)],stdout=diagnostics,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
      print('Sampling verified PID',child.pid,scenario,flush=True)
     rss=subprocess.run(['ps','-p',str(child.pid),'-o','rss='],text=True,capture_output=True)
     if rss.returncode==0 and rss.stdout.strip():row['rss_samples_kib'].append(int(rss.stdout))
    row['exit_code']=child.wait()
    assert row['exit_code']==0
    assert profiler is not None
    row['sample_exit_code']=profiler.wait()
    assert row['sample_exit_code']==0 and sample.exists()
    assert sum(x.startswith('sample-us ') for x in lines)==batches
    assert f'focus-ok {scenario}\n' in lines
    row.update(output=log.read_text(),sample=sample.read_text(),sample_log=sample_log.read_text())
   finally:
    if child.poll() is None:child.terminate();child.wait()
    if profiler is not None and profiler.poll() is None:profiler.terminate();profiler.wait()
  save();print('Completed',scenario,flush=True)
 assert all(sha(root/k)==v for k,v in proof['sources'].items())
 assert all(sha(k)==v for k,v in receipt['installed_sha256'].items())
 assert sha(base_path)==receipt['original_fixture_sha256']
 assert all(sha(row['fixture'])==row['fixture_sha256'] for row in receipt['rows'])
 receipt['status']='passed'
except BaseException as error:
 receipt.update(status='failed',error=str(error));raise
finally:save()

import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/chazu/dev/zig/birnam')
work=Path('/tmp/birnam-74t-application-experimental-profile');work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
prefix=Path('/tmp/birnam-74t-aggregate-prefix').resolve()
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
proof_path=root/'docs/measurements/74x-literal-control-production-correctness.json'
proof=json.loads(proof_path.read_text())
assert proof['status']==proof['production_verification']=='passed'
assert all(sha(root/k)==v for k,v in proof['sources'].items())
base_path=root/'bench/native-tier-focus.birnam';base=base_path.read_text()
paths=[prefix/'bin/birnam',prefix/'share/birnam/rust-install.json',*sorted((prefix/'lib').glob('*.dylib'))]
receipt={'status':'running','scope':'Diagnostic native sampling of existing application workloads with unboxed numeric, loop invariant, closure elision and literal-callee developer switches enabled together. This checks application results under their combination; it is not a new full production proof. No host qualification, timing comparison or speed claim. Collection repetitions increase from 5 to 25 only to allow sampling; cold materialization retains the original 5 batches. Sampling starts after reported warmup. RSS readings are point samples, not process peaks.','correctness_sha256':sha(proof_path),'source_sha256':proof['sources'],'original_fixture_sha256':sha(base_path),'installed_sha256':{str(p):sha(p) for p in paths},'driver_sha256':sha(__file__),'rows':[]}
out=work/'receipt.json'
def save():out.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
save()
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('BIRNAM_','DYLD_','BENCH_'))}
flags=dict(BIRNAM_DEV_UNBOXED_NUMERIC='1', BIRNAM_DEV_LOOP_INVARIANTS='1', BIRNAM_DEV_CLOSURE_ELISION='1', BIRNAM_DEV_LITERAL_CALLEES='1')
env.update(flags);receipt['experimental_flags']=flags
try:
 for scenario,batches in [('portable-collections',25),('materialize-cold',5)]:
  fixture=work/(scenario+'.birnam');code=base.replace('[5 timesRepeat: [|',f'[{batches} timesRepeat: [|');fixture.write_text(code)
  assert code.count(f'[{batches} timesRepeat: [|')==1
  log=work/(scenario+'.log');sample=work/(scenario+'.sample');sample_log=work/(scenario+'-sample.log')
  row={'scenario':scenario,'batches':batches,'fixture':str(fixture),'fixture_sha256':sha(fixture),'rss_samples_kib':[]}
  receipt['rows'].append(row);save()
  print('Starting',scenario,flush=True)
  with log.open('w') as output, sample_log.open('w') as diagnostics:
   child=subprocess.Popen([str(prefix/'bin/birnam'),str(fixture)],cwd=root,env=dict(env,NATIVE_TIER_FOCUS=scenario),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=output,text=True,bufsize=1)
   row['pid']=child.pid
   profiler=None
   lines=[]
   try:
    for line in child.stdout:
     output.write(line);output.flush();lines.append(line)
     if line.startswith('warmup-us ') and profiler is None:
      assert child.poll() is None
      identity=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-ww','-p',str(child.pid),'-o','command='],text=True).strip()
      row['sampled_process_start']=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-p',str(child.pid),'-o','lstart='],text=True).strip()
      assert str(prefix/'bin/birnam') in identity,identity
      row['sampled_process']=identity
      profiler=subprocess.Popen(['sample',str(child.pid),'3','1','-file',str(sample)],stdout=diagnostics,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
      print('Sampling verified PID',child.pid,scenario,flush=True)
     rss=subprocess.run(['ps','-p',str(child.pid),'-o','rss='],text=True,capture_output=True)
     if rss.returncode==0 and rss.stdout.strip():row['rss_samples_kib'].append(int(rss.stdout))
    row['exit_code']=child.wait()
    assert row['exit_code']==0
    assert profiler is not None
    row['sample_exit_code']=profiler.wait()
    assert row['sample_exit_code']==0 and sample.exists()
    assert sum(x.startswith('sample-us ') for x in lines)==batches
    assert f'focus-ok {scenario}\n' in lines
    row.update(output=log.read_text(),sample=sample.read_text(),sample_log=sample_log.read_text())
   finally:
    if child.poll() is None:child.terminate();child.wait()
    if profiler is not None and profiler.poll() is None:profiler.terminate();profiler.wait()
  save();print('Completed',scenario,flush=True)
 assert all(sha(root/k)==v for k,v in proof['sources'].items())
 assert all(sha(k)==v for k,v in receipt['installed_sha256'].items())
 assert sha(base_path)==receipt['original_fixture_sha256']
 assert all(sha(row['fixture'])==row['fixture_sha256'] for row in receipt['rows'])
 receipt['status']='passed'
except BaseException as error:
 receipt.update(status='failed',error=str(error));raise
finally:save()
